name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 about 2.5% below its high; no large daily falls this week
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,638 on 3 Nov, about 2.5% below its 52-week high, with no single-day fall above 2.5% this week. Its weighting to energy and mining has cushioned it from the US technology sell-off. The Bank of England decides on rates on 5 Nov, with a rise widely expected.
for_you: UK shares are steady; pensions and ISAs tracking the index are close to recent highs.
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.

rubric.watch: Drawdown 5–12%, or a single-day fall > 2.5% this week.
